data.title: Juve vs Napoli: where to watch on TV and live stream, Sky or DAZN? | Gazzetta.it
data.content:
A fiery atmosphere is expected in the clash scheduled at the Allianz Stadium between Juventus and Napoli. Neither side is enjoying a good run and both are looking for a victory that can halt the crisis; both Spalletti and Allegri are under scrutiny and risk slipping further down the table. A bumper crowd is expected: kick-off at 20:45, with referee Sozza in charge.

VIDEO: Allegri rinuncia al ricorso contro la squalifica: la battuta fa ridere tutta la sala stampa [...] ## how juve head into the match

—

Following the defeat against Genoa, Spalletti took the squad into a training camp, receiving the club's backing once again during Carnevali's meeting with the team. A reaction on the pitch is expected, while Ekhator is back available and can provide another option in attack.

## how napoli head into the match

— [...] —

Allegri will return as a former manager but will not be able to sit on the bench due to suspension: Landucci will take charge in the Napoli dugout. Napoli have not repeated the same result in any of their last seven Serie A matches, alternating between three wins, two draws and two defeats: despite this, the Partenopei have scored at least three goals in three of their last four league matches, as many times as in their previous 31.
